nodes.label: The ?since= delta cursor must be the server's own clock
nodes.source_location: The ?since= cursor is the one thing to get right
nodes.rationale: The engine's delta window is updatedAt >= since - 5s, deliberately at-least-once; a literal > since silently loses rows to clock skew and millisecond truncation.
